topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: The metal beast, quiet and stiff, nestled in the familiar place, yet today it was gone. Tracks of rubber marked the earth, leading away, a trail of disturbance. The air held a different taste, a whisper of unfamiliar movement where the beast once stood still. The space now open felt both strange and somehow right, an urge to explore the changed territory, to see what new things might now take root or wander in. The silence, where the beast's hum once thrummed, invited my ears to other sounds, subtle calls and quiet rustles that had been overshadowed. I moved, not with haste but with purpose, to claim this new clarity, this altered domain.
